The implementation changes correctly match the test-defined spec, and the agent properly identified that the tests require strictly less than width rather than at most width. Update the docstring to accurately reflect that lines must be strictly less than width characters to maintain consistency between documentation and implementation. This is important to prevent confusing future developers who will read the docstring before encountering the test behavior. Since the agent was clearly aware of this issue, it would be straightforward to fix.
